title: "visualize_example"
output: html_document

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)

load('sample_data.rda')
```

```{r}
ggplot(result) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = g_area)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "inferno") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(result) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = dng)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma") +
  theme_minimal()
```
